# The state each source reads for each class of the answer of its service:
# <class> <source> <state>. TestPIPResponse_EachClassReadsToTheStateOfItsCell
# compares the agent with it; REGOGEN_UPDATE_PIP_TABLE=1 rewrites it.
# A changed cell changes what a deployed policy decides. An encoding cell
# of ERROR may become the status/200 state once the agent decodes that coding.
